value.body: A two-year master's in public administration. It covers administrative theory, Indian and comparative administration, public policy, personnel and financial management, development administration and local governance, often with a project or dissertation.

items.label: Course length
items.note: 4 semesters; widely offered through distance and open universities

items.label: PG students in Public Administration
items.note: All PG programmes in the subject
items.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 13, actual responses (Ministry of Education)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A bachelor's degree, in many universities in any subject. Central and many state universities admit through CUET-PG; others hold their own entrance test or admit on graduation marks.

value.title: At a glance
items: Many students take it alongside civil-services preparation, since Public Administration is a UPSC optional subject.
College teaching needs UGC-NET or a Ph.D. after the master's.
Non-government routes include NGO and CSR programme roles, policy research and administration.

value.title: Postgraduate enrolment in Public Administration
value.note: Counts all PG students in the Public Administration discipline (Social Science), across all modes reported. AISHE counts only responding institutions, and coverage varies by year, so part of any change can reflect reporting rather than real growth or decline.
value.source: AISHE 2021-22, 2022-23 and 2023-24, Table 13 postgraduate enrolment by discipline, based on actual responses (Ministry of Education)
